decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the core cheese offer, got its own page in 2019 and costs little to keep, so the option stays open despite no data after 2019.
The spicy cheese survived the 2019 pruning of weaker variants and was promoted to its own page, so its value is not yet disproven and keeping it is cheap.
The mild creamy soft cheese was featured at launch and got a dedicated page in 2019, unlike the dropped washed-rind soft cheese, which suggests it has enough promise to keep.
